type: Hero mockup for a dark-themed technology brand landing page.
goal: Generate a main visual for a high-end landing page targeting men's skincare, overall appearing tough, professional, and trustworthy.

header.logo: Upper left 'NEX SKIN' ultra-thin sans-serif uppercase text + silver-gray 'MEN · ALL-IN-ONE' below

left_column.headline: Refreshing feeling, starting from daily 30 seconds care
left_column.sub_headline: Men's skin needs simplicity even more
feature_highlights: ● Oil control: intelligent regulation of sebum
● One bottle does it all: toner + serum + lotion

center_image.subject: Fresh and capable Asian male in his 30s, clean short hair, neatly trimmed beard, wearing a dark gray turtleneck sweater
center_image.pose: Right hand gently supporting the chin, gaze looking to the left front, confident yet restrained

right_column.product_shot: Tall and slender deep navy blue frosted bottle (120ml), printed with electric blue 'NEX SKIN' text and a water molecule structure diagram, with tiny water droplets clinging to the bottle opening.

items: JD and Tmall dual rankings, men's skincare TOP 1.

style.rendering: Deep space blue background + highlight metallic reflection + electric blue particles + clean commercial photography
style.lighting: Main light on the model outline on the left side, product backlit outlining on the right side

constraints.must_feel: Rugged, professional, reliable, like a real landing page for a high-end men's skincare brand.
avoid: Include pink, warm colors and other girly style elements
Model's expression is overly gentle or fake smile.
Text on the bottle body is blurred and unreadable
